title: Slime mold out-designs the Japanese subway

tellings.quote: If you have slime mold sort of, if you put scat in the shape of the Japanese subway system, the slime mold can figure out a more efficient route than the actual Japanese subway system.

plain: Slime mold, a simple living thing with no brain, can work out a more efficient route than Japan's real subway system if you lay out food in the shape of that network. That is how Tero Isokauppila, a guest who talks about mushrooms and fungi, tells it to Jesse Michels, passing it on as something he was told rather than something he did. If it holds, it suggests that even very simple life can solve hard design problems.
